resources.string: Prayer times, qibla and the Quran. Free forever. No ads, no account, works offline.

Authorities differ on how far below the horizon the sun must be for Fajr and Isha. Pick the one your local mosque follows.

Move your phone in a figure of eight a few times. Magnetic interference from metal, cases and speakers can throw the reading off.
Move away from metal, magnets, cases and cables. The compass cannot read the Earth’s field while something nearby is stronger.
